summary.intent: Finish and push WP E (native name resolution) as a PR, then implement WP I: resolve relative `workspace:../path` npm dependencies through a single directory index to speed up large pnpm workspace loads.
summary.outcome: WP E was pushed as PR #561 on trail #357. WP I was implemented (NpmDirIndex/LazyNpmDirIndex in walk.rs, duplicate resolution removed from npm.rs, pnpm relative-path perf fixture and bench shape added, changeset written), all four gates passed, and it was committed; mutation testing on it was the next step.

repo: Workspace crates include callisto-graph, callisto-manifests, callisto-model, callisto-fixtures and callisto-cli; relative `workspace:` resolution previously happened twice (npm manifest parsing and graph walk).
The npm manifest now emits `workspace:<suffix>` for relative paths and leaves resolution to the graph, which resolves it against its own canonical dir index.
Perf fixtures live in crates/callisto-fixtures/src/perf.rs and are driven by the callisto-cli `commands` bench, configurable via CALLISTO_BENCH_PACKAGES.
Changesets are created with `cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add --package cargo/<crate>:<bump> --summary ...`.
Gate sequence per work package is pre-push, lint, doc-check and test; clippy is run with `-D warnings` and reduced debug profile settings plus CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 to keep builds light.
The `entire` CLI links branches to trails (`entire trail link <n> --base main`, `entire trail ci-pr`) and has `agent-help` subcommands for discovery.
Mutation testing is run via a custom script (mut.sh) and a `--test-threads 4` flag had to be removed from it.

code.finding: Replaced the per-dependency `relative_workspace_package` scan with NpmDirIndex (canonical dir -> PackageId map built once) wrapped in a OnceCell-based LazyNpmDirIndex that caches build failures.
Removed duplicate relative-path resolution and the `workspace_root` field; relative paths now always yield `workspace:{suffix}`.
Gained a pnpm relative-path shape so the bench can reproduce the quadratic scan; at 800 packages status went from ~4.9s to 0.6s.

workflow: Multi-line source edits were done via Python heredoc scripts and temp files under the job tmp dir, which required rerunning when edits failed and a second perf edit pass.
Spawning a review agent in parallel with running the gate saves wall-clock time.
Commit signing is verified with `git log -1 --format='%h sig=%G?'`.
Removing `target` between worktrees is used to save disk space.

friction: The mutation script's `--test-threads 4` flag was wrong and had to be removed with sed before the rerun.

Several edit scripts (edit_i.py, edit_perf.py, edit_perf2.py) were needed, and the first clippy run after the inline edit was redone after the edit script, suggesting the initial edit did not fully apply.
Worktree switching (ExitWorktree/EnterWorktree) and `rm -rf target` between work packages added overhead.
open_items: Mutation testing results for WP I were not yet seen at the end of the transcript.
The review agent's feedback on the dir index diff had not been incorporated or reported yet.
